findings.issue: UnreadNotificationsCard wraps its body in <InfoCard title={title} className={className}>, and when used as the Content component of HomePageWidgetBlueprint (which renders CardExtension's own <InfoCard>), it renders a nested InfoCard inside an InfoCard with duplicate 'Unread notifications' headers.
findings.fix: Extract and export `UnreadNotificationsCardContent(props: Pick<UnreadNotificationsCardProps, 'limit' | 'pollingIntervalMs'> = {}): JSX.Element` that renders the loading, error, empty, and unread list content without an outer `InfoCard`, and have `UnreadNotificationsCard` render `<InfoCard title={title} className={className}><UnreadNotificationsCardContent limit={limit} pollingIntervalMs={pollingIntervalMs} /></InfoCard>`.

findings.issue: `unreadNotificationsCard` passes `Content: m.UnreadNotificationsCard` to `HomePageWidgetBlueprint.make`, causing `CardExtension` in `@backstage/plugin-home-react` (lines 176-188) to wrap `UnreadNotificationsCard`'s `InfoCard` inside a second `InfoCard`.
findings.fix: Update `components` in `unreadNotificationsCard` to `() => import('./components/UnreadNotificationsCard').then(m => ({ Content: m.UnreadNotificationsCardContent }))` so `CardExtension` renders the single outer `InfoCard` around the card content.

findings.issue: The extension test `'renders the unread-notifications HomePageWidgetBlueprint extension from alpha plugin'` only checks that the notification item text is in the document and does not verify that `'Unread notifications'` is rendered as a single card header rather than nested duplicate `InfoCard` headers.
findings.fix: In `'renders the unread-notifications HomePageWidgetBlueprint extension from alpha plugin'`, assert `expect(screen.getAllByText('Unread notifications')).toHaveLength(1)` after awaiting the notification row.
